import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                size='weight_grams', alpha=0.6, data=df, legend='full')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels (Size: Weight, Color: Sensor Type)')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
